verdict.rationale: Amplitude documents several export mechanisms in open formats: event data export, cohort export/upload, and dashboard data via JSON REST API (amplitude-docs-12, amplitude-docs-29, amplitude-docs-30), which supports data portability for an AI-native user. However there's no documented single 'export everything and leave' workflow (full account/data dump, session replay data export, or explicit data-deletion/portability guarantee), so it only partially satisfies the story. Missing for 10: comprehensive full-account export covering all data types (session replays, experiment configs, flags), explicit data portability/deletion policy, and independent confirmation that exports are complete and usable outside Amplitude.
